title: PitchBook Public Profile Scraper

profileUrls.title: Public PitchBook URLs
profileUrls.description: Use this when you already have public PitchBook profile, research, or news URLs. Enter up to 25 HTTPS URLs such as https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/127635-40. When direct public HTML is unavailable, the optional Google fallback can recover only publicly indexed title and description metadata. The actor rejects login, dashboard, and private subscription URLs.

maxItems.title: Maximum records
maxItems.description: Use this when limiting cost and run time. Sets the number of accepted URLs to process, from 1 to 25; default 10. It is not a search-results limit because this actor does not discover or crawl private PitchBook pages.

useApifyProxy.title: Restricted access control
useApifyProxy.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

useGoogleSearchFallback.title: Restricted access control
useGoogleSearchFallback.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
